    • runActionAndPublishEvent

      protected void runActionAndPublishEvent(com.netgrif.application.engine.objects.workflow.domain.eventoutcomes.petrinetoutcomes.ImportPetriNetEventOutcome outcome, PetriNet saveProcess, List<Action> actions, Map<String,String> params, com.netgrif.application.engine.objects.event.events.petrinet.ProcessEvent event)
      Executes a list of actions associated with a Petri net and publishes a corresponding event after execution.

      This method is responsible for running the specified actions using the event service, updating the provided ImportPetriNetEventOutcome instance with the outcomes of the executed actions, setting the processed Petri net, and publishing the given event through the application event publisher.

      Parameters:
      outcome - the ImportPetriNetEventOutcome instance where the results of the action executions are stored
      saveProcess - the Petri net that has been processed and potentially saved
      actions - a list of Actions to be executed
      params - a map of key-value pairs containing execution parameters for the actions
      event - the ProcessEvent associated with the execution and used for event publication
